format_note: Manifest of the Quick chat agent configuration for review and rebuild. Quick does not import this file; build the agent from it per docs/SETUP.md section 5b. Every ARN and ID stays a placeholder here; real values live only in the Quick account or in gitignored runtime files.
name: Loan Origination Agent
description: Presents the Acme Bank "Harborview Logistics" commercial loan origination demo from Amazon Quick. Orchestrates the Salesforce Loan Origination (LOS) and Box connectors to find the latest loan, surface critical policy-risk documents, extract and validate term-sheet terms against credit policy, compare covenants across prior executed loans, and generate and send the commitment letter for signature. Every write is confirmed by a person.
starter_prompts: run the Harborview loan origination demo
What's the latest loan for Harborview Logistics?

scoped_skills.name: loan-origination-quick
scoped_skills.note: Import from the repository file or the archive built by scripts/package_loan_skill.py --skill loan-origination-quick. Reference the tools of both connectors in the skill editor before publishing.

connectors.note: The hosted Salesforce MCP server LOSLoanTools (docs/SETUP.md section 5a). The ARN is environment-specific; do not commit a real value.
Box MCP connector. Enable read and write tools for Box Doc Gen and Box AI in the Box Admin Console, then reconnect (docs/SETUP.md section 5a).

demo_setup_defaults._comment: Presented by the skill's Demo Setup step; the operator can override each at runtime. Values are environment-bound and live in config/runtime/quick-demo-defaults.json (gitignored); copy config/runtime/quick-demo-defaults.example.json to create it.

provenance.notes: Loan ID and loan folder ID are always resolved dynamically via listLoans(borrower='Harborview Logistics'); they are never part of setup.
